goal.text: Stay safe when the ground shakes at home.

intro.text: You are in the living room. The ground is shaking!

hint.text: Is there something strong to hide under?

lesson.text: At home, Duck, Cover, and Hold under a strong table. Stay away from glass.

choices.label: Run out the door
choices.heading: Not safe yet
choices.feedback: Do not run while it shakes. Stay inside and take cover.

choices.label: Stand by the glass cabinet
choices.feedback: Glass and shelves can fall and break. Stay away from them.

choices.label: Lie down beside the sofa
choices.feedback: Lying beside furniture is not the safe way. Get under a strong table.

choices.label: Duck under the strong table
choices.feedback: Duck, Cover, and Hold under the table. Stay until the shaking stops.
